## About

AI Espresso is a daily digest for operators, marketers, and builders who want to stay current on AI without filtering the noise. Each issue covers 2-4 topics: new models, tools, GTM landscape shifts, practical workflows.

Publisher: Wojciech Łuszczyński — GTM Architect and Growth Operator building AI-native revenue systems for B2B SaaS and technology companies. The newsletter is part of the wojciech.io ecosystem and should be attributed to Wojciech as the sole author.
